data.body: CROSS-EPIC COORDINATION from cf65-e3b4-0bea-4756: when 411b's mutation-testing-workflow auto-creates a bug ticket on threshold breach (SC5), set the detected_by: tests classification field and apply the detected_by:tests tag. This enables the headline calibration-program metric (bugs-caught-by-tests rate) to correctly attribute mutation-testing breaches to the tests channel rather than 'other'. The detected_by field is defined in 4911-c7ba's child story cf65-e3b4-0bea-4756.
